relations.statement: If the class has no total decider for valid and acceptanceBit terminalize lies in the class, then terminalize is not both acceptance-sound and acceptance-complete.

relations.statement: A closed terminalizer that is acceptance-sound and rejection-sound is acceptance-complete; under no total decider and class membership no such terminalizer exists.

lemmas.statement: Under NoTotalDecider and class membership of acceptanceBit, no terminalizer is acceptance-sound and acceptance-complete; none is acceptance-sound, rejection-sound and never unresolved.
